title: Mall
subtitle: 「商場／購物中心／購物廣場／零售綜合體」，究竟是哪一種 mall？
description: 「商場／購物中心／購物廣場／零售綜合體」，究竟是哪一種 mall？

words.note: British English 最自然、最廣泛的核心對應。通常指有多間商店、餐飲及服務設施的集中式購物場所，可為室內或大型綜合式設施。
words.example: The new shopping centre includes more than eighty shops and several restaurants.

exercises.original: The new mall near the station has more than eighty shops, restaurants, and a cinema.
exercises.zh: 車站附近的新商場有八十多間商店、餐廳和一間戲院。
exercises.upgrade: shopping centre · 購物中心；商場

options.explanation: 多間商店、餐飲與娛樂集中於同一大型場所；在 British English 中 shopping centre 是最自然的一般稱呼。
較正式的規劃／物業詞，強調整個多單位零售開發項目。 本句只是日常描述一個有大量商店、餐飲與娛樂設施的商場，沒有規劃、開放式 plaza、歷史 arcade 或廣義商業區等額外線索。 因此在這一句裡不如 shopping centre 精確。
多見於 North American English，常是低層、開放式、配有共用停車場的小型商業群。 本句只是日常描述一個有大量商店、餐飲與娛樂設施的商場，沒有規劃、開放式 plaza、歷史 arcade 或廣義商業區等額外線索。 因此在這一句裡不如 shopping centre 精確。

通常是有頂通道兩旁排列商店的較窄、較小型購物空間。 本句只是日常描述一個有大量商店、餐飲與娛樂設施的商場，沒有規劃、開放式 plaza、歷史 arcade 或廣義商業區等額外線索。 因此在這一句裡不如 shopping centre 精確。
比 mall 範圍更廣，可包括辦公、銀行、金融和專業服務。 本句只是日常描述一個有大量商店、餐飲與娛樂設施的商場，沒有規劃、開放式 plaza、歷史 arcade 或廣義商業區等額外線索。 因此在這一句裡不如 shopping centre 精確。

words.meaning: 零售綜合體；大型商業設施
words.note: 較正式，強調由多個零售單位、餐飲、停車或其他商業設施組成的一整個開發項目。常見於規劃、房地產和商業語境。
words.example: The developer plans to build a large retail complex beside the motorway.

exercises.original: The developer submitted plans for a mall containing shops, restaurants, parking, and office space.
exercises.zh: 發展商提交了一個包含商店、餐廳、停車場和辦公空間的商業綜合體計劃。
exercises.upgrade: retail complex · 零售綜合體；大型商業設施

options.explanation: developer submitted plans + mixed commercial facilities 指房地產／規劃語境，retail complex 比 everyday shopping centre 更正式。

exercises.original: The mall consists of several low-rise shops arranged around a shared car park.

words.example: The shopping complex includes a cinema, supermarket, and food court.

exercises.original: The mall combines a supermarket, cinema, gym, restaurants, and dozens of shops in one development.

exercises.original: The former mall district now contains shops, banks, offices, restaurants, and professional services.

exercises.original: The mall attracts visitors from neighbouring cities who travel there specifically to shop.

falseSynonyms.zh: shopping centre 是 British English 最常見的一般對應；mall 在 North American English 更常用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We spent the afternoon at the shopping centre. We spent the afternoon at the mall.

falseSynonyms.zh: shopping plaza 往往較小、低層、開放式並配有停車場；典型 mall 常更大型或室內化。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The plaza has a row of shops facing a car park. The mall has three indoor levels.

falseSynonyms.zh: shopping arcade 通常是有頂通道兩旁排列商店的較窄型空間，不等同一般大型 mall。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The Victorian arcade has a glass roof. The mall contains more than a hundred shops.

falseSynonyms.zh: shopping precinct 是一整片購物區，常為行人專用；它不一定是一座建築。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The shopping precinct is pedestrianised. The mall is an enclosed building.

falseSynonyms.zh: retail complex 是較正式的規劃／物業詞，強調整個多設施開發項目。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The developer acquired the retail complex. Families spent the afternoon at the mall.

falseSynonyms.zh: commercial centre 範圍更廣，可包括辦公、金融與專業服務，不只購物。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The district is a major commercial centre. The mall mainly contains shops and restaurants.

falseSynonyms.zh: retail destination 是市場定位／吸引力概念，不是建築類型。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The development is a major retail destination. The mall has four floors.

falseSynonyms.zh: outlet mall 是 mall 的特定子類，主要集中品牌 outlet stores；不能泛指所有商場。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We visited an outlet mall to buy discounted designer goods. The city-centre mall contains ordinary department stores and cafés.
